setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Pattern 1 has trigs on steps 1 to 4 and is assigned to channel 1, which loops steps 1 to 4. Channel 1's Masks are Note C3 (60), Vel 80 and Len 1/2, and the tempo is 90 BPM. Playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold (1,4), tap (16,4) and release (1,4): the range is now 16 steps, one bar. On row 4, steps 5 to 16 now glow dimly because they are inside the loop (they were dark at range 4), and the trigs are still on steps 1 to 4. Then open the Clock page for the next step: turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Clock and press K3.
steps.title: Loop all 16 steps

steps.caption: On CLOCK CH01, check that Rate reads /1 before pressing K3.
steps.title: Read the selected rate

steps.caption: Select Rate (the top row of the CLOCK page; turn E2 up if it is not highlighted) and press K3. CLOCK CH01 shows Rate /1, the default sixteenth-note rate: each step lasts 1/6 s at 90 BPM and the 16 steps last 2.7 s. Nothing changes here; this confirms the rate that every timing in the course relies on.
steps.title: Check the rate

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8), tap (2,4), (3,4) and (4,4) to remove those trigs, then tap (5,4), (9,4) and (13,4) to add trigs. Keep (1,4). PATTERN TRIG PAT01 CH01 shows trigs on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13: four steps apart is one beat at 90 BPM.
steps.title: Move the trigs onto the beats

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note C3, Vel 80 and Len 1/2 as before, and row 4 of the grid shows the four trigs one beat apart inside the 16-step range. Masks stays open so chapter 5 starts on the page it needs.
steps.title: Open Masks for the next chapter

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two 16-step passes run (about 5.3 s), then tap Play to stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4, one beat at a time over the four trigs. The MIDI strip shows note 60 (C3) at velocity 80 once per beat, about 667 ms (2/3 s) apart: the same note as chapter 3, spread over a bar instead of 167 ms apart. Stop leaves no note sounding.
steps.title: Hear the longer phrase

title: 4. Spread the rhythm across a bar
